Name: FNS Coal Regen
Author: FinFNS
Description:
[center][size=6][b]FNS Coal Regen[/b][/size]

[left][/left]
[/center]
[size=4]Tired of those minecarts staying empty forever after you've looted them?[/size]
[size=4]
[b]FNS Coal Regen[/b] makes coal-filled minecarts renewable in The Mines. After looting a minecart, its coal will regenerate the next day when you return to that mine floor, giving you another reason to revisit previously explored levels.[/size]


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Minecart coal can regenerate on previously visited mine floors on the next day.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works automatically during normal mining and exploration.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]No need to start a new save.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Lightweight and focused, no unrelated gameplay changes.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]SMAPI[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]Installation
Install with your preferred mod manager, or extract [b]FNS Coal Regen[/b] into your Stardew Valley[/size]

[code]Mods[/code][size=4]folder.[/size]

[size=5][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size]
[size=4]Remove the [/size][b][size=4]FNS Coal Regen[/size][/b][size=4] folder from your [/size]
[code]Mods[/code][size=4]directory.[/size]
[line]
[size=1]* The "AI Media" tag was applied for the thumbnail(s) and page-art of this mod.
** The "AI Assisted" tag was applied because AI was used in some portions of this mod's creation. Human hands, eyes, and brainpower was used to create and test this mod thoroughly. This is not vibe-coded AI-Slop. [/size]

Manifest.Name: FNS Coal Regen
Manifest.Description: Modern recreation of Coal Regen. Regenerates coal carts and coal bags in the mines.
